title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - WasteProcessingOrganisation
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/WasteProcessingOrganisation. Organisation in the waste processing industry that has waste processing sites. Subclass of org:Organisation (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.1); org:Organisation is out of this candidate's scope. No explicit object/datatype property is declared with this class as domain in the ontology (the 'has waste processing sites' relationship is descriptive prose only, not a formal OWL property), so no relationship is modelled here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WasteProcessingOrganisation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
